segmentation.text: or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency,
making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of
the driver of every other vehicle shall,
except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:

elements.justification: 'authorized emergency vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'); ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate', never expanded. Its exclusion of a role described by conduct is respected: the conduct the words require (flashing lights, immediate approach) is carried by u4 and u1, not by the class.

ru.official_vehicle 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment; kind in {... regulatory_agency ...}', read with kind regulatory_agency (DEF-NRS-484A-205: an agency 'granted police or enforcement powers'). Its exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: an emergency vehicle' is respected: the emergency vehicle is u2's aggregate.

sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit; colour in {red, blue, amber, white}, mode in {flashing, rotating, steady}, facing in {front, rear, side}'. The requirements quoted from DEF-NRS-484A-480-3, 'at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front', give the lamp the approaching vehicle makes use of: lit, colour red, mode flashing, facing front. Its exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: an audible warning' is respected: no siren is required by these words.

'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'every other' excludes the approaching vehicle itself (the two variables do not denote the same road user). 'driver' is a relational role (ru.aggregate is not a stand-in for who controls a vehicle), read through the vehicle's controlled motion. Mapping index: 'the driver of a vehicle' maps to the same aggregate.

Mapping index: 'unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer' maps to dev.governs, dev.human_direction, rel.occupies, st.travel_region. dev.human_direction 'a person directing traffic and the direction given; role in {police_officer, ...}', read with role police_officer; dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls', its exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: a position' respected since it only ties the officer to the subject's region; rel.occupies anchors the subject on a travel region (st.travel_region) the officer governs.

Mapping index: 'shall yield' maps to kin.speed, rel.contact. The subject yields to the approaching vehicle while it moves (kin.speed above the halt tolerance); rel.contact 'touch or overlap (a collision)' is a failure to yield, not a stand-in for a near miss, which u9 carries.

operationalizations.standard: the immediate approach of the emergency or regulatory vehicle
operationalizations.convention: the vehicle approaches: it moves (speed above the speed resolution) with the subject ahead of it in its own frame; the approach is immediate within the centre distance a vehicle at an urban response speed covers in the time a driver needs to perceive its lamps and begin clearing the way

operationalizations.standard: the right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210 'approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other'
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: closest approach of the two centres under constant velocities within the time-to-collision threshold at a centre distance below the collision clearance

compositions.quote: at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front

applicability: There is a road user e, not the subject, that is of the authorized-emergency-vehicle aggregate or an official vehicle of kind regulatory_agency, shows a lit warning lamp of colour red, mode flashing, facing front, and is in immediate approach of the subject: e moves (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance), the subject lies ahead of e in e's frame (longitudinal component of rel.bearing from e to the subject positive), and their centre distance is at most p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach. And no human_direction device of role police_officer governs a travel region the subject's footprint overlaps.
obligation: For every such e: where the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance), the subject and e are not in contact, and it is not the case that their closest approach falls within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Ambulance e (authorized-emergency-vehicle aggregate) with a lit red flashing front warning lamp moves toward the subject from behind within p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach, the subject ahead of it. The subject keeps moving in e's path: their closest approach falls within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the subject has moved to the right lane: no closest approach within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_centre_clearance, no contact.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: e approaches as in forbid but its warning lamps are off (no lit sig.warning_lamp).

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but sig.warning_lamp is not observed on the source, so whether e makes use of the required lamps is unknown while the subject is in conflict with it.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but a police officer (dev.human_direction, role police_officer) governs the lane the subject occupies and directs it.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: An official vehicle of kind regulatory_agency with a lit red flashing front lamp approaches as in forbid and the subject's body touches it (rel.contact).

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's vehicle-state estimates

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: centre distance within which an emergency or enforcement vehicle closing on a road user with its warning lamps flashing is in immediate approach: about five seconds of travel at an urban response speed of 20 m/s, the time a driver needs to perceive the lamps and begin to clear the way
param_proposals.source: driver-response studies of emergency-vehicle encounters (perception-reaction time plus lane-change time)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash
param_proposals.source: traffic-conflict technique literature (Hyden; FHWA Surrogate Safety Assessment Model)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width
